I am sorry to hear about the damage to your property. As Beldesk, I can assist with municipal regulations, but I cannot provide legal advice regarding lawsuits. For legal rights, please consult a lawyer or the local bar association.

However, if there is unauthorized construction, our municipal building control team can inspect the site. To report this, I need the exact address of the construction. Is there an immediate risk of collapse?

Category: Zoning/Illegal Construction
Location: missing
Proposed urgency: P2 — Potential structural damage and unauthorized activity

Please provide the street address and confirm if this report is correct so I can forward it to our inspection team.
